review.reason: Reviewed equivalent atomic inventory counters under Rust 1.99. Immutable object bytes, manifest CAS, WAL candidates and receipt recovery are unchanged.
Reviewed enum indirection and equivalent validation guards; canonical native object bytes, identities and public serialized fields remain unchanged.
Reviewed released Kingfisher scanner 1.4.0, rules 1.2.1 and core 1.0.3. Updated capture documentation for versioned policy/cache namespaces; privacy failure still withholds publication.

Reviewed equivalent SCP remote parsing with strip_prefix: accepted hosts, paths, endpoint identities and local repository authority remain unchanged. Existing Git and conversion documentation still describes the supported forge profile.

Reviewed ordinary-local forge contracts, contextual CLI help and Stack/Workspace controls: exact submission and recovery, CI and protected merge, explicit Restack. Git guide and transport documentation describe transient tokens and separate live/provider/package gates.
Reviewed equivalent native read-context iteration after release lint cleanup. Rebuildable search authority and bounded read behavior are unchanged.
Reviewed sync semantic projection suppressing idle scheduler churn while preserving checkpoint, pause and fault notices; replication authority is unchanged.

Reviewed capture scheduling fixture setup and body-free timeout diagnostics. The multi-step prefix test now prepares the qualified rule cache before its unchanged scheduling deadline; production capture, storage, configuration schemas and lifecycle behavior are unchanged.

Reviewed stack forge parser/orchestration and explicit CLI automation credential selection. CLI index and Git guide cover PR/submission/recovery/restack families and preserve exact intent and qualification limits.

Reviewed the exact 202-route inventory including LocalTrusted integrations and repository forge endpoints. The test now explicitly requires both endpoints and retains every method, media, HEAD, operation identity and security assertion; wire contracts are unchanged.

Reviewed mapped browsing, editing, settings and conversion guides after the shared chat Jump to end focus/scroll repair. Browsing now explains draft focus before scrolling, full-draft visibility and immediate reduced-motion navigation. Provider setup, draft retention, command authority, conversion and credential contracts remain unchanged.

Reviewed the equivalent optional ACP regular-file and symlink guard in Resources::from_root against lifecycle documentation. Fresh desktop Clippy, complete workspace tests, native checking and staged restart acceptance pass; private installation, owner lifetime and independent signed-platform gates remain unchanged.

Reviewed generated integration inventory/command schemas and current forge CLI help. Transport and CLI pages document metadata-only account responses, explicit automation credentials and exact-request recovery; generated references remain authoritative.

Reviewed the maintained local-agent hint and bounded catalog simplifications, unchanged item ordering, lexical synthetic request lock and nonempty request-read assertion against the compute, agent and security guides. Permission/cancellation, backend credential custody, single-attempt metadata and uncertain-inference no-replay behavior retain their exact tests and contracts; native GGUF/live-provider/platform gates remain separate.
Reviewed Cargo distribution metadata only; read-index source, exact-root fingerprints, posting invariants, bounded retention and native authority separation remain unchanged.

Reviewed equivalent forge let-chain guards after strict Rust lint: stale PR identity rejection, retained navigation context and latest-check filtering preserve short-circuit order and documented submission/check/credential semantics.
